name: The British Empire
description: The British Empire from the first colonies in America to the handover of Hong Kong: the conquests, the trade, the resistance and the end of empire.

checkpoints.name: First colonies
checkpoints.note: English settlers found colonies in North America and the Caribbean, built on sugar, tobacco and the slave trade. The East India Company trades in India.

checkpoints.name: Empire in India
checkpoints.note: The Company conquers India from Bengal. Britain loses the American colonies, founds Australia, and abolishes slavery.

checkpoints.name: The height of empire
checkpoints.note: Opium Wars, the Indian Rebellion and the Scramble for Africa. Under Queen Victoria the empire covers a quarter of the world.

checkpoints.name: The end of empire
checkpoints.note: The dominions become self-governing, India is partitioned and freed in 1947, African colonies follow, and Hong Kong is handed back in 1997.
